title: Mouse Without Boarders - can't find other PC after update

status.label: Needs Information
status.detail: After upgrading PowerToys 0.85.1, two MWB PCs stopped discovering/connecting; service startup and saved IP mappings did not restore operation.

next_action.label: Confirm MWB mapping source
next_action.reason: Confirm current release and mapping source before treating #51127 as a covering fix.

judgment.rationale: The issue already has logs, a detailed setup and an author answer to the old 0.87 request; do not repeat a generic log request. The deciding facts are whether it still occurs on current stable and whether mappings are policy-managed or user-entered.
judgment.recommended_action: Confirm current release and mapping source before treating #51127 as a covering fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The likely PowerToys path remains uncertain; the proposed direction is provisional and paired with the specific evidence request.

proposed_fixes.title: Apply the correct MWB IP mapping source consistently after update
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A policy/user mapping precedence mismatch could explain why a configured peer remains undiscovered, but mapping type and current release coverage are unknown.
plan: Identify whether each peer mapping is user-entered or policy-managed.
Trace the selected mapping source through service startup and peer discovery after update.
Add regression coverage for the mapping source shown to fail, including a no-user-rule case if policy-managed.
verification: Repeat on current stable with the same two-PC configuration.

confidence.rationale: Detailed logs and a merged policy-mapping change are available, but mapping ownership and current-release behavior are unconfirmed.

issue_context.summary: After upgrading PowerToys 0.85.1, two MWB PCs stopped discovering/connecting; service startup and saved IP mappings did not restore operation.
known_information: Reporter described two Windows 11 PCs and repeated update-related connection loss.
They attempted reboot/reinstall, service mode, firewall-rule installation and saved IP mappings.
Two MWB mini logs are attached; author said issue persisted after the 0.87 follow-up.
Timeline links tracking #51077 and merged PR #51127 for policy IP mapping when no user rules, plus #51170.
inferences: PR #51127 may matter only for policy mappings; the report does not establish that, and merge alone is not evidence the fix is in a released build.
issue_context.analysis: The issue already has logs, a detailed setup and an author answer to the old 0.87 request; do not repeat a generic log request. The deciding facts are whether it still occurs on current stable and whether mappings are policy-managed or user-entered.
initial_investigation: Timeline links merged PR #51127 for policy mapping behavior and open #51170; this is potentially relevant, not demonstrated coverage.
Service status and repeated restart/reinstall make a one-time restart inadequate diagnosis.

information_gaps.information: Whether issue persists on current stable and whether mappings on both PCs are user-entered or Group Policy-managed.
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether PR #51127 is relevant and distinguishes a released fix from a remaining connection failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Check About on both PCs and identify each mapping as a normal MWB Settings entry or policy-provided; do not share policy values or private addresses. Existing logs need not be reattached unless a fresh failure occurs.

comment.body: Thanks for the two MWB mini logs, two-PC setup, and details about service mode, firewall rules and saved IP mappings. Merged PR #51127 changes policy-provided mappings only, so it may not cover your setup. Could you confirm whether this still reproduces on latest stable on both PCs and whether each mapping is entered in MWB Settings or supplied by Group Policy? Please do not share private IP addresses or reattach old logs. This will show whether #51127 applies or another reconnect path remains broken.
